lines.en: : She’s been sitting there for like an hour.
: Yeah...I feel kind of bad.
: Dude. You’re too nice.
: Isn’t she a bitch to you like, literally every day ever? You shouldn’t feel bad just because she’s alone.
: I know...but imagine if that were me or you.
: It probably took a lot of courage for her to even come here today. Especially since Chika isn’t here.
: Oh! Is Chika not here? I didn’t even notice. Hahahah!
: That’s the same exact response you’ve had to that every single time it’s been brought up today.
: I mean, how weird would it be if I were to just...keep tabs on where Chika is at all times, right? Hahahah.
: That would be like, totally stalkerish. Who even is Chika? I’ve never heard that name before.
: Right...
: Well, uhh, anyway! Why don’t we get back to talking about that girl over there? The one with the surprisingly hot body that I’m totally not jealous of.
: Her name is Yumi...You know that...
: Yeah, that girl. What do you wanna do?
: What do you mean?
: I mean, this is all on you. I’m just here for moral support.
: I thought you were gonna have one of those breakthrough things and approach her.
: That’s what it seemed like you were leading up to at least.
: Approach her and do what? The second I go over there she’ll just make some joke about...whales or something again...
: Then fuckin’...kick some sand in her face and call her a loser or something. I don’t know.
: That doesn’t sound like moral support, Rin...
: Well...then how about this? Both of us will go over there and try talking to her normally. Like she’s any other girl in class.
: That has never worked before and I can’t imagine it working right now. But it’s a nice idea.
: Ugh, this is so stupid. Why does she have a problem with you of all people?
: You’re like the sweetest and nicest and cutest and smartest girl I know. And you’re always looking out for everybody.
: And your boobs are like “BAM!”
: Literally don’t get it at all.
: It’s because of my weight...She just...seems to have a problem with that for some reason.
: Well, that’s a stupid thing to take issue with. I think you’re adorable and I see you more than anyone, so that should mean something.
: It does mean something. Thanks.
: And for the record, I can’t imagine ever having any wingman other than you. So thanks for looking out for me all the time.
: Dude, duh. Thanks for looking out for me all the time. I’m the loopy one. You’re just getting picked on by some girl with...self-esteem issues or something.
: Actually, now that I really think about it, what is her deal anyway?
: I don’t know, like...anything about Yumi. Which is weird because I know like six million things about Chika.
: Chika? I thought you didn’t know anyone named Chika?
: Wait, did I say Chika?! I meant...Chicken! I know a lot of...facts about chickens!
: Name three...
: Feathers! Wings! Beaks!
: Those are just parts of the chicken, Rin. They aren’t really facts...
: They are! Now let’s...go do the thing or whatever!
: Hah...
: Guess there’s no harm in trying again...
: Here goes nothing.
Three girls in a line on the beach.
One calm. One callous. One concerned.
And despite the girls having zero chemistry when inserted into the petri dish we call society, they do their best to emulate conversation as if they’re lifelong friends.
The only issue is that two of them are while one has a hard time comprehending why she’s here in the first place.
But such is life.
No one knows why they’re here.
There are those who think they know.
But they, too, are just specimens in petri dishes waiting for someone to come along and identify their purpose.
Oh, how disgusting it is to watch them squirm beneath the microscope.
: Yo! Mind if we join you?
: Uhh, yeah. Kind of.
: What do you want?
: Oh, nothing. Just wanted to sit by the water for a bit.
: You know there’s water fuckin’ everywhere, right? We’re at the beach.
: This isn’t the beach. This is a bathtub.
: Heh?
: Sorry. It’s a thing. I swear.
: You’re fucking weird.
: What’s the problem with that?
: Being weird is fun. You should try it sometime.
: Pass.
: Bad enough that I have to sit next to-
: Oh! That reminds me!
: I was wondering if maybe you’d want to come eat dinner with Futaba and me tonight?
: What? Why?
: Well...you know! Food! It’s a good way to bond with people or whatever.
: We were in class together in middle[school], weren’t we?
: Surprised you remember. I barely showed up back then either.
: Yeah...Hey, that’s when you and Chika started hanging out, right?
: ...Oh, right. Forgot who I was talkin’ to for a sec.
: Listen, I don’t know where Chika is. You have her number, don’t you? Just fuckin’ text her.
: No point invitin’ me to hang out just to get info on her.
: That’s-
: That’s not what Rin was trying to say...
: Oh?
: Then what was she trying to say, fatass? Enlighten me.
: Hey! I don’t know what your deal is, but that’s my friend you’re talking-
: It’s fine, Rin. Don’t worry about it.
: Ugh...whatever.
: We just...saw you sitting here alone and thought maybe you might be a little happier if you were hanging out with people.
: I know it’s hard to not have anyone you’re close to around and-
: Oh, boo-fucking-hoo. It’s not like I’m sitting alone because I’m afraid of talking to anyone or some boring shit like that.
: I’m sitting alone because I like being alone. End of story.
: And now that you two showed up, my nice, quiet evening has been trashed and I’m going to go home pissed off.
: So fucking annoying. I have no idea how Chika puts up with bein’ nice to people all the time and shit.
: All I want is for everybody to just stay out of my fucking business.
: It’s bad enough having to fuckin’ fend off the god damn teacher all the time, but now I have to deal with you dipshits as well? Fucking Christ.
: Why bring Sensei into this? He’s not even here right now.
: Bullshit. Dude’s always lurkin’ in the background somewhere. He’s probably behind a tree jerking off to us right now.
: Sensei isn’t like that, Yumi...He really does care about us.
: Care?! You think that fucking pervert cares about us? Jesus, you’re even dumber than I thought!
: Just because he asks you to suck him off all the time doesn’t mean he fuckin' cares about you! He’s using you!
: Woah! Slow down! Who said anything about sucking anyone off?!
: Sensei is a good guy and wouldn’t ever force anyone to do anything they don’t want to!
: Oh, if you only knew fucking half of it.
: And what’s with that shit about “not doing anything they don't want to do?” You think it makes it okay for a teacher to fuck his students as long as they’re okay with it?
: Dude...
: What?
: What happened to you?
: The fuck are you talkin’ about?
: I just don’t get how you can be so uptight all the time...We literally just came over here to ask if you wanted to eat with us.
: I’m not normally one to regret my decisions but...fuck, Yumi. You went and turned our nice gesture into a left field attack on our teacher.
: Hey, you’re the ones who decided to come and talk to me. Ain't my fault if you regret it.
: If you dislike it so much, why don’t the two of you fuck off and go eat or whatever instead of wasting your time inviting the class delinquent?
: Oh, Hell no. We’re not going-
: Let’s go, Rin.
: What?...
: Really?...
: After all that you just want to leave?
: Yumi wants to be left alone, so we should leave her alone.
: It’s not our place to force her into doing anything she doesn’t want to do.
: Wish everyone would fuckin’ think that.
Miscommunications.
Misunderstandings.
The circumstances and situations we find ourselves in often lead to nothing but anguish at the end of the day.
Forming bonds sounds more like a pipe dream when factoring in how they would impact others if we could only peer through the looking glass.
Three girls in a line on the beach.
Each involved in a different relationship with the same man.
Each with a different view of him.
How is it possible for three people to be so closely linked and yet so far apart?
Such is the petri dish.
And such is life.
Perhaps we are not all meant to be happy.
And perhaps the girl in the middle of the line is meant to destroy herself in pursuit of what makes the other two whole.
Praise be!
Not one god, but three!
The further we fall, the more we will see!
HOPE is the answer, but won’t be the key!
The day drags on.
